changes: Shared artifact policy includes SQLite rollback sidecars, including historical tree paths.

Streaming raw-byte scanning now also scans UTF-16 LE and BE at both byte alignments with independent overlap/line cursors. BOM-less and binary-embedded text are included; scanned-byte counts are not inflated.

Terminal flex descendants can shrink to their parent width; proposed cell dimensions are bounded before resizing both the rendered terminal and native PTY to the same supported size. Hidden/unmeasured dimensions retain a valid existing grid.

sourceScan.note: Interim scan before remaining integration changes; repeat at freeze.
